title: PHASE 2 — rank-basis refresh + state re-basing: derivation, classification, implementation

derivation.factorization: masked LoRA A_t = U @ A0 (rank x in), B_t = B0 @ U^T (out x rank); effective dW = scale*B_t@A_t = scale*B0@A0 (U orthogonal cancels)
derivation.refresh: U_old -> U_new  =>  R = U_new @ U_old^T (rank x rank, orthogonal). A_new = R @ A_old ; B_new = B_old @ R^T -> effective dW INVARIANT.
derivation.commutes_with_gamma_fold: R acts on the RANK dim; the gamma fold M acts on the INPUT dim -> they commute, so applying R to the plaintext master is consistent with the masked re-fold.

classification_A_to_E.A_preserves_SGD: ANY invertible R (SGD linear-equivariant): rebase theta only.
classification_A_to_E.B_preserves_momentum: ANY invertible R: rebase theta + first-moment buffer (m -> R@m / m@R^T).
classification_A_to_E.C_preserves_elementwise_AdamW: SIGNED-PERMUTATION / monomial R ONLY. Then g^2 is a pure permutation of g_old^2, so v transports EXACTLY as v_new = |R|-permutation of v_old.
classification_A_to_E.D_requires_trusted_reconstruction: DENSE orthogonal R for AdamW: elementwise v CANNOT be transported exactly -> v must be reconstructed/re-initialized in the trusted enclave (implemented as v<-0).
classification_A_to_E.E_invalid: claiming a dense R preserves AdamW v exactly; or a non-invertible R (loses rank information).

main_exact_AdamW_refresh_family: signed permutation / monomial R (Class C) — used for the exact profile.

implementation.enclave: TrustedAdamW.rebase(R, mode) in scripts/tdx_adamw_protocol.py (modes: signed_perm exact / dense reconstruct-v / params_only NEGATIVE-CONTROL theta-only); service op rebase_adamw; version increments.
implementation.runner: scripts/a10_mixed_runner.py --refresh-every/--refresh-mode/--refresh-kind/--refresh-inconsistent: rebases GPU-exact factor master+moments locally + sends R to enclave for trusted-state rebase (consistent U_old->U_new).
